claims.heading: Description
claims.observation: Research, tracking and trading are separate advertised uses; advertised local storage is not an independently verified security guarantee.

claims.heading: Multi-Agent System
claims.observation: Research summaries, strategy automation and scheduled news are advertised. This does not establish a committee UI or evidence drill-down.

claims.heading: Flexible Integrations
claims.observation: Several model providers, markets, agent frameworks and exchanges are described. No adapter is admitted here.

claims.heading: Advanced Notification & Push Types
claims.observation: Advanced alerts are listed in the roadmap; shipped desktop notification behavior is unverified.

claims.heading: Memory & Learning Systems
claims.observation: Persistent conversation history is listed in the roadmap; immutable versioned research history is a QuantOS requirement.

claims.heading: Third-Party Components & Licensing
claims.observation: External widgets and APIs have separate terms; Apache-2.0 does not confer market data or exchange rights.
